entries.lead: Tuning wizard records layout choices from the selected platform
entries.text: The tuning wizard reads the selected platform's packaged template when it records clustering, distribution and sort choices, instead of always reading the DuckDB template, so Snowflake clustering choices reach table_tunings. When no template for that platform and benchmark defines the layout (Redshift distribution and sort keys, BigQuery clustering), it prints a not-enabled warning and records nothing instead of printing a success line. Partitioning still comes from the platform-independent default partitioning profile.
